title: Hiring Managers Are Judging You On These Things
description:

transcript: Secret things that hiring managers are judging you about that they would never tell you. First one is your email address. If your email address is partygirl69@hotmail.com, change it. Yes, they look at it and yes, they care. The second one is your makeup style. I had a candidate come in for an interview with really bright blue eyeshadow and it was the only thing that the hiring managers could talk about. She also was the craziest candidate we've ever experienced, but the blue eyeshadow really drove that home. This one I hate to admit, but your accent. Now, they shouldn't and this is obviously biased and illegal, but sometimes if the accent is too thick, they just will decide on another candidate and they call it better communication style. Your Zoom background. Hiring managers and interviewers are really looking back there. So, blur it out. They don't need to see last night's takeout still on your couch. Hiring managers notice everything and they judge you on everything. Is it fair? No. Does your takeout on the couch have anything to do with how well you'll do the job? No. But, we always have to remember we need to control what we can and professionalism is one of those things that we can control.
